name: workspace-object-action-selection-audit
originalRequirement: M1 objects must be locatable from Workspace and return to the correct file and internal position without turning WorkspaceHome back into a format capability page.

candidates.userValue: Complete or restore an explicitly typed task row directly from Today's tasks and open its stable row location.
candidates.semanticBoundary: Only .table.json rows with a strict boolean column named 完成, 已完成, done, or completed and a resolvable text title column.
candidates.writeBoundary: A narrow backend mutation must re-read the internal Table, verify workspace scope, file signature, row ID, column ID, boolean type and old value, then reliably write one boolean value.
candidates.conflictBoundary: Reject stale signatures or changed/missing row and column identities without modifying the file; refresh Workspace after failure.
candidates.undoBoundary: Undo uses the successful mutation receipt and its new signature to restore the prior boolean value.
candidates.navigationBoundary: Opening the item uses the shared table-row locator and returns to the exact stable row ID.

candidates.reason: OPML nodes have stable navigation and source save, but no reserved completion semantic; treating arbitrary nodes or attributes as tasks would invent meaning.
DOCX objects are editable through contextual drafts, but headings and paragraphs do not carry a safe workspace-action semantic.
Supported edits create a new copy and require a target-path decision; direct Workspace completion would hide the required copy boundary.
ODP remains read-only, so only navigation is currently safe and it adds no new daily action beyond Continue work.
Supported edits require contextual object operations, transaction preview and explicit source-save confirmation; there is no generic task-state operation.
Workbook editing is safe inside its full draft model, but there is no reserved task schema and cell safety depends on validation, formulas, merges and object context.

selectedNextStage.name: internal-table-boolean-task-workspace-action
scope: Discover bounded internal Table task rows in the Workspace overview without delaying the first actionable content.
Show Table tasks inside the existing Today task surface without adding a new dashboard card or format statistics.
Open the exact row through the shared table-row locator.
Complete, restore and undo one row through a narrow signature-protected mutation with reliable write and failure refresh.
excluded: Arbitrary boolean columns or inferred task semantics
OPML, DOCX, ODS, ODP, PPTX or Workbook mutations
